question.text: Presence of a nitro group in a benzene ring

options.text: activates the ring towards electrophilic substitution
deactivates the ring towards nucleophilic substitution
deactivates the ring towards electrophilic substitution

solution.text:
$-\mathrm{NO}_2$ group shows $-\mathrm{M}$ effect, so withdraws the electron density from the ring and hence deactivate the ring towards electrophilic aromatic substitution.
Hence, (D) is correct.
